pages.title: Antibody Bench
pages.text: A sterile hood over a rack of vials and a cold store: a trace of an invader is grown, made harmless and measured into doses.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set the dose and the adjuvant. The body's response grows with the dose as a Hill curve, D²/(K² + D²), and the adjuvant raises it; it must reach the recipe's level. Past dose x (1 + adjuvant) of 150, the imprint resonates.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Antibody, CAR-T Cell Culture, Fracture Ward, Grey Goo Ward, Hollowing Ward, Lasting Fracture Ward, Lasting Grey Goo Ward, Lasting Hollowing Ward, Lasting Rewind Ward, Memory Cell, Rewind Ward.
$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Antibody Bench$(): Clonal Selector, Selection Chamber
